entities.summary: Naubakht Ahvazi, also spelled Naubakht Ahvaz and Naubakht, was a renowned astrologer from Ahvaz who lived in the 8th and 9th centuries AD. Born in the 7th century AD, Naubakht's sons, along with him, were astrologers who worked in the city of Ahvaz. The family's expertise was sought by the Abbasid Caliphate, and they were consulted on various matters, including the alignment of celestial bodies and the timing of important events. Naubakht's contributions to astrology were significant, as he developed new methods for predicting eclipses and planetary movements. His work had a lasting impact on the field, influencing generations of astronomers and astrologers. Naubakht's legacy can be seen in the many astronomical tables and manuscripts that bear his name. Despite the passing of centuries, Naubakht's work remains an important part of the rich heritage of Islamic astronomy.
